title: 2 Year Apprenticeship Programme (m/f/d)
description: **Damovo** is a global managed ICT solutions and services company. Damovo Global Services is the global delivery organisation within the Damovo Group. Headquartered in and managed from **Dublin** , we support many large Fortune 500 companies across the world. Our operations span over 150 countries with a local presence in Ireland, UK, Poland, Germany, Belgium, Luxembourg, Netherlands, USA, Costa Rica, Philippines, Singapore and Malaysia. **Overview** Our **2\-year apprenticeship programme** offers the opportunity to join an agile, fast\-moving organisation. As part of a team of 600 employees, you can expect to work in a very open and agile culture, where freedom to voice your ideas is encouraged and facilitated through flat structures and supportive management. Upon completion of the apprenticeship, you will have Unified Communication experience across various technologies such as Microsoft Teams, Genesys and Cisco Webex which will help in your further career progression in the industry. At Damovo we are passionate about enabling complete connection – across people, processes and systems. We improve the way people collaborate using the very latest digital technologies from the world’s leading technology vendors – including Microsoft, Avaya, Cisco and Mitel. Our portfolio of managed communication and collaboration services create transparency and agility whilst also providing the network resilience and security our customers’ demand. You will be supporting both Irish and global customers. This varied role will provide the successful candidate with on\-the\-job training, working with experienced professionals providing valuable insights into a variety of different fields of expertise. **What is involved in the Damovo apprenticeship?** You will study towards a Higher Certificate in Telecommunications and Data Network Engineering, which is a technician apprenticeship by successfully completing all external assessments through TU Dublin, Tallaght. You will develop skills both on\-site and in the classroom. Whilst in the classroom you will cover Network Installation, Health and Safety, Telecommunications and Technology \& Service Restoration, Electrical Principals, Customer Service, Broadband \& Wireless Skills, Optic Fibre Installation, Maintenance \& Commissioning and Personal \& Professional Development. You will bring what you have learned in the classroom into the workplace where you will not only get to put what you have learned into practice, but will also get hands on experience with: * Maintaining computer environments both on\-premise and in the cloud * Maintaining and managing the Testing Environment in our internal laboratory. This will include ensuring all equipment and applications, both physical and virtual, are viable and fit for purpose with the support of the relevant senior engineers * Monitoring computer systems to improve performance for all systems * Troubleshooting, resolving, and communicating issues to other employees and management * Other relevant learning opportunities as they arise **What we are looking for** * Leaving Certificate completion * Willingness to learn Unified Communications and Contact Center technologies through both on\-the\-job and classroom\-led learning * Good computer literacy and a strong interest in a career in IT * Customer service experience * A good communicator, both written and verbal * Excellent problem\-solving skills * Proactive, can\-do attitude demonstrating initiative * Can work well both individually and as part of a team * The ability to attend TU Dublin (Tallaght) and to commute to our offices * A commitment to successfully complete the 2\-year apprenticeship * Full driving licence with access to your own vehicle, as travel to customer sites will be necessary as part of the role

title: 2027 BNY Summer Internship Program - Audit (Dublin)
description: **Audit Practice**Internal Audit is an independent function at BNY that helps the organization succeed by assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal control environment. Through a combination of risk assurance and advisory support, the team provides analyses, insights, and recommendations that promote effective risk management and control. Interns in Internal Audit receive targeted on\-the\-job training and work alongside experienced audit professionals to build technical knowledge, strengthen soft skills, and learn how audit drives impact across the organization. **What you will do*** Support audit work by reviewing processes, risks, and controls across different parts of BNY’s business and operations. * Help analyze information, document observations, and identify themes that may point to control gaps, inefficiencies, or opportunities to improve. * Contribute to audit testing, walkthroughs, and reporting that help teams understand how effectively processes and controls are working. * Partner with audit professionals and business stakeholders to gather information, ask thoughtful questions, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights. Gain exposure to how governance, risk management, and internal controls support a global financial services company. * **Skills you will build*** Risk and control thinking * Analytical problem\-solving and critical thinking * Business process analysis * Written communication and concise reporting * Professional skepticism and sound judgment * Collaboration and stakeholder communication Attention to detail and documentation discipline * **Impact you will have at BNY*** Help teams identify risks earlier and improve how key processes and controls operate. * Contribute to work that promotes accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across the organization. * Support insights and recommendations that help protect the firm and strengthen the control environment. * See how independent review and objective analysis create real value in a complex global business. **Why this could be a fit for you**This role is a great fit if you like asking smart questions, solving problems, connecting details to the bigger picture, and doing work that helps organizations operate more effectively and responsibly. **Summer Internship Program** The BNY Summer Internship Program offers high\-potential students a dynamic 10\-week experience designed to accelerate development, build professional networks, and provide meaningful exposure to one of the world's leading financial services institutions. Through a skills\-driven talent model, interns gain insight into the capabilities, platforms, and functions that power BNY's global franchise while contributing to impactful business initiatives. From day one, interns are immersed in BNY's collaborative and innovative culture through: * Enterprise\-wide onboarding and development programming, including an in person immersive induction experience, executive speaker series, skill development, and networking opportunities. * Meaningful project work aligned to key business practices and platforms, providing hands\-on experience, skill development, and real\-world business impact. * Structured mentorship and career support from managers, senior leaders, peer mentors, business stakeholders, and dedicated program managers. * Exposure across practices, platforms, and teams, building a broad understanding of BNY's integrated business model. * Professional, technical, and financial services training designed to strengthen business acumen and prepare participants for long\-term career success. A premier early\-career experience, backed by senior leadership and designed to develop the next generation of talent for BNY's global workforce. * **Program eligibility:*** Enrollment in a 3 or 4\-year undergraduate degree program with a strong focus on business\-related and/or technology\-related majors preferred * Graduating in Dec 2027 or Summer 2028 * On track to achieve a 2\.1 or higher * Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.

title: 2K Games - Engineering Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. Kickstart your career with 2K’s Engineering Graduate Program. **Program Overview** The Engineering Graduate Program starts July 2027\. Based out of our Dublin, Vancouver and US offices, launch your career in game development over a 21 month period. * Foundation Training (3 Months): Master game development fundamentals using industry\-standard engines, engage in instructor\-led projects, receive guided feedback \& reviews, and develop essential soft skills for working in a studio environment. * Studio Rotations (18 Months): Complete 3 rotations across 2K studios (such as Hangar 13, Visual Concepts, Firaxis, HB Studios, Gearbox, and more), contributing directly to AAA titles. **What You Will Do** * Collaborate with multi\-disciplinary engineering teams to build and support game features across our titles. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code, primarily in C\+\+ \& in the Unreal Engine. * Participate in instructor\-led group projects, technical workshops, and guided reviews. * Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize systems across diverse engineering platforms and game engines. * Adapt quickly to varied studio workflows, version control tools (e.g., Perforce), and game release timelines. **Who You Are** * Graduated between January 2025 and July 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field. * Proficiency in programming languages such as C\+\+, C\#, or Python. * Experience with the use of Unreal Engine, which will be evaluated during the assessment process. * Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design patterns. * Solid debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities with strong attention to detail. * Proactive, curious learner with a genuine passion for gaming and technology. **How To Apply** The next cohort of engineers will join us in July 2027\. We will open recruitment starting on September 14th and encourage you to apply today and not wait before it is too late! Apply with a CV/resume and full information regarding academic history as requested on the application portal. Be sure to include any additional links (GitHub, itch.io, etc) to show us some of the cool things that you do! As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform their essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need a reasonable accommodation. Please note that 2K Games and its studios never use instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, recruiters only use 2K.com, take2games.com or zynga.com accounts.

title: 2K Games - Publishing Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. Publishing Graduate Program Our graduate program is a rotation\-based journey through our business, based in Dublin, London or Novato, with the possibility of a rotation in one of our international offices. You'll help shape your own experience as we match your learning goals to our business needs. What is the Publishing Graduate Program? When people hear ‘publishing,’ they usually think “books”. At 2K, it means everything that happens outside of game development to bring games to market and get them in front of players: advertising, budget planning, marketing technology, live services, growth strategy, player insights and analytics, and go\-to\-market planning. Our rotations give you hands\-on experience across the whole publishing organisation. Before You Apply... Who are we looking for? We hire less for a specific degree and more for how you think and work. Across the business, the graduates who thrive tend to be curious, take ownership of their work and think critically about what they're being asked to do, as well as take feedback well. Beyond that, our graduates join us from science, economics, engineering, philosophy, social sciences, arts, and everywhere in between. Our recruitment process is task\-based, so you get a real chance to show what you can do. Once you're in, our foundation training and ongoing development mean you're never figuring it out alone. We consider a “recent graduate” to be anyone who has graduated within two years of the program (January 2025 \- June 2027\) start date in July 2027\. Do I have to be a gamer? Not at all. Some of our graduates have never played a game, while others play every day, and both bring perspectives that we value. Whether you're an avid gamer or picking up a controller for the first time, you'll have a point of view to bring to any team you join. How do we recruit? We keep our process short and straightforward, because we know applying for jobs is stressful enough. We hire for analytical thinking, tested across three areas: quantitative skills, qualitative skills, and how quickly you pick up something new. Combined with your interview, that's how we get a sense of the curiosity, drive and critical thinking we're looking for. If that sounds like you, we'd love to receive your application. What Will I Be Doing? The program starts with training to set you up with foundational skills. After that, you'll take on a maximum of six three\-month rotations across our publishing teams, from marketing and brand to product and player science. By the end of the program, you'll walk away with three core skill sets: analytical, technical, and commercial. We don't expect people to arrive with all three, and that's the point. We're looking for people with the potential to grow, and we'll help you get there. You can explore each rotation in detail on our graduate programme page. What Happens After the Program? By the end of the program, you'll be ready to specialize and apply for permanent roles across the business, whether that's digital marketing, marketing technology, or analytics. You'll have built a well\-rounded skill set, from advanced Excel to our own approach to project management, and be well prepared to take on a role and thrive in it. At the core of this program is a commitment to growing our own future leaders, and we're fully invested in giving you the training and path to get there. title: 2K Games - Technical Art Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. What is Technical Art? Technical Artists make the art team more capable than it would be on its own. The art team is your customer, its problems set your priorities, and your work is judged on whether the artists it was built for actually use it. In practice that means building the tools artists use to create content, the rigs that make characters move, the shaders that give a world its look, the rules that scatter a landscape with vegetation, and the pipelines that carry all of it into the game. Program overview 21 months, starting Summer 2027, based in Dublin. **Foundation Training. Eleven weeks.** You get a brief, a deadline, and the tools art teams use every day, and you work out how to deliver. You build across all four specializations, including the ones you are weakest in: Pipeline and Tools, Character and Animation, Rendering and Visuals, Environment and World. What you build is reviewed by people who do this for a living, and the review covers how you worked and how you talked to the people you built it for, not only what you delivered. Some of the work is yours alone and some is shared with the Engineering and Publishing graduates. Foundation Training runs on Unreal Engine, Maya, Python, and Perforce. The program assumes you arrive knowing one or two of them, not all four. **Three strategic rotations, six months each.** Rotations run across our studios, including Hangar 13, HB Studios, Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Small Axe, and Gearbox, and across the central technology teams that build the tools and pipelines every studio shares. Which team you rotate onto is decided around game timelines, and what the teams need at the time, and your own developing focus is part of that conversation. What we are looking for An outstanding portfolio is the first thing we look at, and it should show the work and how you got there. It does not have to be an art portfolio. Tools, scripts, rigs, shaders all count. If the work was made with other people, tell us which parts were yours. **There Are Two Things You Need** * Comfort in at least one content\-creation package or game engine. Maya, Blender, Houdini, Substance, Unreal Engine, or whatever you happened to learn. * Some scripting. It does not need to be much, but you should be able to read code and have written something. **Beyond That, The Qualities That Matter Most** * Curiosity. You want to know how things are made, and you dig in to find out. * Persistence. A lot of this job is being stuck: something is broken, the reason is not obvious, and you keep going until you find it. * Communication. You will spend more time talking and asking questions than most people expect. **Education.** Game Art, Animation, VFX, Technical Art, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. We also take people with any unrelated degree who have a portfolio that shows the work. What you have made matters more to us than where you studied. The key is that you have a recent degree. **Experience.** No games industry experience is needed. This is a graduate program, and it is built for people who have never worked in games. Mod work, game jams, university projects, and freelance work are all relevant experiences as far as we are concerned. **Recent graduates.** Eligible Grads from January 2025 to June 2027 are eligible to apply. Exceptions may be made on a case\-by\-case basis if your grad date falls outside of these dates. Technical Art is a job people arrive at from many directions, so apply even if you do not match every line above. How to apply Send a CV/resume and a portfolio. The portfolio can be an ArtStation page, a personal site, a GitHub profile, an itch.io page, a reel, or a PDF. Which platform it lives on matters much less than whether we can open it and follow what we are looking at. If your work is spread across several places, link all of them and tell us which one to start with. If your resume doesn't explicitly have Tech Art, you're welcome to create a cover letter for us to review telling us why you're interested in this program. Cover letters are entirely optional. title: AI Intern - 6 Months (2 positions)

This internship offers hands\-on experience in developing and testing AI and automation solutions, with a focus on GenAI and agentic workflows. title: APOC Live Team Member

Businesses managed by the NTMA include borrowing for the Exchequer and the management of the National Debt, the State Claims Agency, the New Economy and Recovery Authority (“NewERA”), the Ireland Strategic Investment Fund, National Development Finance Agency and the NTMA Future Ireland Funds business unit with responsibility for the management of the Future Ireland Fund and Infrastructure, Climate and Nature Fund. legal, statutory and regulatory requirements. * Strong integrity. * A strong stakeholder focus, with the ability to engage positively and effectively with individuals across the organisation. * detail. **Knowledge/Qualifications** * The candidate should hold an honours primary degree. **Próifíl an Róil** Teideal an phoist: Oifigeach Rúnaíocht na Gníomhaireachta Roinn/Feidhm: Príomhoifigeach nGnó** Cuireann Gníomhaireacht Bainistíochta an Chisteáin Náisiúnta (GBCN) seirbhísí bainistíochta sócmhainní agus dliteanas ar fáil do Rialtas na hÉireann. title: Chief Medical Scientist
description: **CHIEF MEDICAL SCIENTIST (MICROBIOLOGY)** **Reporting To:** Administratively – Laboratory Manager Clinically – Consultant Microbiologist **Job Summary:** To participate in planning, co\-ordinating and promoting all activities within the relevant department ensuring the achievement of agreed targets and standards. The fundamental philosophy guiding this position is to promote and preserve the Bon Secours Mission, Values and Ethos. **Duties and Responsibilities** Under the general direction and control of the Laboratory Manager and the Consultant Microbiologist, the Chief Medical Scientist will be responsible for the following: **General:** * Be responsible for the daily operation and performance of the microbiology service, ensuring internal and external measures of quality are in place. * Provide strategic and clinical leadership, which results in the delivery of effective, efficient, quality assured and patient centred laboratory service. * In collaboration with pathology and hospital management, develop a vision for the service and deliver that vision through strategic planning and project management * Develop a shared sense of commitment and participation among staff in the development of the microbiology service. * Ensure open channels of communication between Senior Management and laboratory staff to promote an open and well\-informed workplace. * Collaborate with the Laboratory Manager, Consultants, other Department leads and Service users within a broader laboratory and hospital environment to ensure the service provided matches user requirements and supports the clinical needs of the patient. * Perform routine and specialised work to the highest professional standards. * Demonstrate professional behaviour consistent with the values of the Hospital. * Provide a working environment that stimulates and motivates staff and attracts and retains the best people. **Operations:** * Lead out on the implementation of new procedures, technologies and IT systems. * Advise on equipment selection, purchase, replacement or upgrading. * Participate in future development of the Laboratory Service that support the clinical needs of the patients and are consistent with the mission, vision, values, and strategic plan of the wider Hospital. * Explore new and innovative methodologies to continually improve and modernise the microbiology service. * Make necessary preparations to foresee service failures and plan contingency measures accordingly (such as those required by surges in service demand, power outages, problems with the computer systems, analyser downtime, implementing the Major Emergency Plan etc.) * In collaboration with the Laboratory Manager, identify and implement operational processes in microbiology to the standards of ‘best practice’, optimising the most efficient and effective use of resources. * Identify and communicate resource requirements in the event of altered service demand. * Support, promote and actively participate in sustainable energy, water, and waste initiatives to create a more sustainable, low carbon and efficient health service. * To maintain an asset register of all equipment in the Laboratory, ensure regular preventative maintenance is carried out, hold documentation as appropriate on external maintenance contracts and liaise with equipment manufacturers on maintenance issues. * To take responsibility for monitoring, presenting and troubleshooting internal and external quality assurance procedures. * To ensure there are adequate processes of communication in the department with regard to any changes in policy, methods etc. * To participate in the writing of SOP’s and in any other duties required to secure and maintain Laboratory Accreditation. * To co\-ordinate the training of student medical scientists in addition to new scientific and medical staff as required. * To facilitate and encourage continued education and further training of staff as appropriate and support the career development of staff. * To represent the Laboratory at scientific and other meetings within and outside the hospital as required. * To perform such other duties appropriate to the office as may be assigned to him/her by Laboratory Manager and/or Consultant Microbiologist. **Quality Assurance and Risk Management:** * Oversee the delivery of a high\-quality service to the patient aligned to and compliant with all applicable standards and statutes, including ISO15189\. * To perform tasks and duties in a manner that ensures compliance with relevant regulations so that the requirements of International standard ISO 15189 (current version), JCI accreditation standards for hospitals, and relevant Medical Devices Directives 93/42/EC and 98/79/EC are met. * Have a working knowledge of the relevant INAB, JCI and Health Information and Quality Authority (HIQA) Standards as they apply to the role for example, Standards for Healthcare, National Standards for the Prevention and Control of Healthcare Associated Infections, Hygiene Standards etc and comply with associated hospital protocols for implementing and maintaining these standards as appropriate to the role * In collaboration with the Pathology Quality Manager, ensure compliance with all aspects of the quality management system and ISO:15189 including, but not limited to document control, audit, management of non\-conformances, management of risk and clinical risk in line with ISO 15189:2022\. * Ensure compliance with S.I. (Statutory Instrument) No. 360 of 2005 European Communities, ISO 15189 and IVDR. * Adequately identify, assess, manage and monitor risk within area of responsibility. * Handle feedback relating to the service as required, including responding appropriately to advisory notices from regulatory authorities. * Assume responsibility for the quality of work in the microbiology department and carry out all duties in accordance with Hospital policy and accreditation standards. * Achieve compliance with all legislation and EU Directives on Laboratory Quality and Safety and in conformance with the Hospital’s and Laboratory’s quality and safety policies and procedures. * Observe the strictest confidence, in line with BSHS GDPR policy, when dealing with all aspects of patient or Hospital information. * Participate in Laboratory, Hospital and/or external committees as required. * Develop, update, and review policies, procedures and guidelines for the department and be an active participant in formulating and carrying out hospital policies and procedures. * Maintain a clear understanding of the importance of providing a quality and safe service to all patients. * To attend relevant meetings and to actively participate in formulation of policies, clinical guidelines, operational policy / procedures and the sharing of information. * To investigate all relevant complaints and provide a timely response in accordance with the Hospital protocol, policies and procedures. Take a leadership and management role in relation to all such issues. * Take an active role in the pursuit and maintenance of accreditation in conjunction with relevant Line Managers. **Safety, Health \& Welfare at Work** * Participate and cooperate with legislative and regulatory requirements in relation to Health and Safety as outlined in the Safety, Health and Welfare Act 2005 and the Hospital Safety Statement. * Provide a safe working environment that is compliant with relevant Health and Safety legislation and with the Hospital Safety Statement, where staff are empowered to deliver the required service to the best of their ability. * Maintain a safe environment for all staff in consultation with appropriate personnel and direct staff on procedures to be followed in an emergency or disaster situation. * Ensure that the management of safety, health and welfare is successfully integrated into all activities undertaken within their area of responsibility, so far as is reasonably practicable. * Participate in regular Health and Safety audits. **Education \& Training:** * Keep abreast of scientific and medical research, support research activities and participate fully in the development of the post. * Engage in and support development initiatives and research activities. * Participate in mandatory training programmes and other training as required to keep up to date with developments. * Lead out on multi\-disciplinary training strategies. * Facilitate arrangements for training of under\-graduates and post\-graduates as required. * Provide supervision and guidance to all grades as required (e.g., clerical, domestic, support) * Take responsibility for and keep up to date with current practice by participating in continuing professional development\*. * Encourage and promote professional development of staff, through self\-learning, formal courses, or formal and/or informal on the job training within the Hospital procedures. * Maintain up\-to\-date personal training / retraining records in accordance with laboratory policy. **Financial \& Administrative** * Be accountable for the delivery of a high quality, cost\-effective service, working within approved pay and non\-pay budgets. * Ensure that financial, human and IT resources are deployed appropriately and utilised effectively to support the clinical service to the patients. * Adhere to best practice in the management of stock, procurement of equipment, audit and stocktake, and all matters pertaining to the National Financial Regulations * Represent the Department in meetings, reports, scientific papers, presentations, negotiations, etc. as required and provide data in response to requests. * Provide statistical and management information as requested. * To assist the Laboratory manager and the Hospital Manager in implementing any corrective programme necessary for adherence to financial budgets. * To utilise financial and other information to plan and deliver agreed levels of service. **Human Resource Management** The post holder is responsible, through appropriate line management delegation, for the supervision and development of staff to motivate and maximise their performance potential. Such delegated duties will ensure that: * Staff attendances are optimised in relation to work schedules. * All annual, examination, parental and other leave is scheduled and recorded. * Hospital HR policies are complied with. * Appropriate induction training of new staff * Hospital Health and Safety Regulations are complied with. * Staff review and development is carried out for all staff. * Participate as appropriate in the recruitment and selection process of staff. * Develop, implement and foster a high level of moral amongst staff by effective motivation and communication. * Develop and promote, in conjunction with the HR Department and Line Managers an appropriate training programmes for staff that is consistent with hospital policy and encourages skill mix. * To ensure that annual leave and study leave of all Microbiology staff are cost effectively scheduled to always ensure the availability of cover. * In collaboration with other disciplines, promote good industrial relations **ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS** Candidates for appointment must Possess: * Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Medical Science from the Galway/Mayo Institute of Technology (GMIT). Or * Bachelor of Science (Honours) Biomedical Science, Dublin Institute of Technology (DIT). Or * Bachelor in Science Honours degree in Biomedical Science from the Joint University College Cork – Cork Institute of Technology course AND Diploma in Clinical Laboratory Practice. Or * Certificate in Medical Laboratory Science, Dublin Institute of Technology (DIT), Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) or Galway/Mayo Institute of Technology (GMIT) AND Bachelor in Science (Applied Science) Honours degree (Biomedical option) from the University of Dublin/Dublin Institute of Technology (Awarded prior to 2002\). Or * Bachelor of Biomedical Science, Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) AND BSc (Honours) Biomedical Sciences, University College Cork (UCC). (Awarded prior to 2013\). Or * Diploma in Medical Laboratory Sciences of the Dublin Institute of Technology, (DIT) or the Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) (Awarded prior to 1994\). Or * Certificate in Medical Laboratory Science awarded before 1997 by Dublin Institute of Technology (DIT), Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) or Galway/Mayo Institute of Technology (GMIT). Or * An equivalent qualification validated by the Academy of Clinical Science and Laboratory Medicine (ACSLM). ***And*** Possess one of the following NFQ Level 9 post graduate qualifications or equivalent qualification at minimum Level 9 validated by the Academy of Clinical Science and Laboratory Medicine; * MSc Clinical Laboratory Science, Dublin Institute of Technology. * MSc MicrobiologyMicrobiology, University of Dublin, Trinity College. * MSc Biomedical Science, University of Ulster. * MSc Biomedical Science, Cork Institute of Technology / University College Cork. * MSc Molecular Pathology, Dublin Institute of Technology / University of Dublin, Trinity College. Or * Have attained the Fellowship examination of the Institute of Biomedical Science (Awarded prior to 1999\). And * Possess seven years full time clinical experience (or an aggregate of seven years’ clinical experience) as a medical scientist in a clinical diagnostic laboratory since qualifying as a medical scientist. , two of which were spent in a promotional post. * Demonstrate evidence of Continuous Professional Development. * Must be registered with CORU or eligible for membership upon completion of study or in the process of applying for state registration, see https://www.coru.ie/about\-us/registration\-boards/medicalscientists\-registration\-board/apply\-for\-registration/ **ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE** * Minimum 7\-years post–graduate experience in a Pathology Laboratory, 2 of which must have been spent in a promotional grade. * Knowledge and experience of working in an ISO15189 accredited Medical Laboratory. **DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE** * Experience of working with iLab Laboratory Information System CLOSING DATE FOR RECEIPT OF APPLICATIONS 5TH OCTOBER 2026 *Bon Secours Health System is an equal opportunities employer. description: Dublin **About RSM** As one of the world’s largest networks of audit, tax, and consulting firms, RSM delivers big ideas and premium service to help middle\-market businesses thrive. We are a fast\-growing firm with big ambitions – we have a clear goal to become the premium adviser to the middle market, globally. This vision touches everything we do, motivating and inspiring us to become better every day. If you are looking for a firm where you can build a future and make an impact, then RSM is the place for you. RSM Ireland is one of the country’s fastest growing advisory firms, specialising in the provision of consulting, audit and tax services to leading domestic and international mid\-market clients. We are a key member of the RSM International network and work closely with over 56,000 colleagues in 500 offices, spanning over 120 countries. RSM International is the world’s most rapidly growing accountancy network and currently ranked number six globally. When you join RSM you’ll have a world of opportunity to build the career you want. It’s your future. Own it at RSM. Our clients range from growth\-focused entrepreneurial businesses through to leading multi\-national organisations across many sectors and operating nationally and across borders. **About the role** RSM has a new and exciting opportunity for a graduate or postgraduate who is interested in building a career in company secretarial practice, corporate governance and compliance. This role is particularly well suited to students registering for Ulster University’s Management and Corporate Governance programme or students registering for MSc in Corporate Governance with Hibernia College who want to combine professional study with practical, client\-facing experience. As part of our Company Secretarial team, you will gain hands\-on experience supporting Irish and international clients with statutory compliance, governance administration, board and shareholder processes, company formations and ongoing corporate records. You will work with experienced professionals and have exposure to senior management teams across a broad range of sectors. The role offers structured on\-the\-job training and support while completing the Management and Corporate Governance qualification pathway. The combination of relevant work experience and postgraduate study can support progression towards qualification with The Chartered Governance Institute UK \& Ireland. Responsibilities: * Assistance with the preparation and filing of Annual Returns and taking responsibility for ensuring that clients are aware of their statutory filing obligations. * Assistance with the preparation and filing of ad hoc statutory forms at the Companies Registration Office (e.g. change of officer, change of address etc.) * Assist with Incorporating companies and preparing de\-shelving documents including company officer details and changes to share capital. * Updating and maintaining the company secretarial database. * Maintaining company Minute Books and Statutory Registers. * Assist with incoming post for registered office clients. * Assist with the maintenance of the annual compliance diary to ensure client filings are progressed in a timely manner. * Liaise with clients, colleagues and external advisers in a professional and responsive manner, escalating technical queries to senior team members where appropriate. * Assist with client onboarding and Client Due Diligence through internal systems. * Conduct basic company law and corporate governance research under the guidance of senior colleagues. * Contribute to process improvements within the Company Secretarial function, including the use of technology and standardised precedents to support efficient service delivery. * Responsibility for billing clients and debtors’ collection. * Filing, archiving and general administrative duties. **About the ideal candidate** The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience:* Be registered for, accepted onto, or have a strong interest in completing a Corporate Governance programme or an equivalent governance qualification. * Hold a third\-level degree, ideally in business, law, accounting, governance, management or a related discipline * Have a genuine interest in corporate governance, company law, compliance, board effectiveness and how well\-governed organisations operate. * Be organised, professional and able to manage competing deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy. * Possess strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence dealing with clients, colleagues and external advisers. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook. * Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to managing deadlines and administrative tasks. * Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team. * Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential client information. ***\#RSM is an equal opportunity employer***

title: Customer Assistant

title: Geographic Information System Intern
description: **GIS \& Planning Intern** **About the Role** We are looking for a motivated GIS \& Planning Intern to support EV infrastructure planning and network expansion activities across Ireland and the UK. The role will involve assisting with GIS analysis, spatial data management, and site feasibility studies to support the growth of EV charging infrastructure. The intern will work closely with the Network Planning Team to analyse existing charging networks, identify opportunities for expansion, and contribute to data\-driven planning decisions. **Key Responsibilities** * Support analysis of existing EV charging infrastructure and network coverage. * Assist with EV infrastructure site feasibility assessments and network expansion studies. * Prepare maps, GIS visualisations, and analytical reports. * Help identify network gaps, demand opportunities, and spatial trends. * Assist in the management, maintenance, and analysis of spatial datasets. * Support the development and improvement of GIS workflows and planning methodologies. * Collaborate with planning, operations, and commercial teams on infrastructure planning projects. * Contribute to research and data collection activities to support strategic planning initiatives. **What We Are Looking For** * Recently completed, a degree in GIS, Geography, Urban Planning, Transport Planning, or a related field. * Understanding and hands\-on experience of GIS concepts, spatial analysis, and mapping techniques. * Experience using ArcGIS Pro or QGIS through coursework, projects, internships, or personal learning. * Interest in EV infrastructure, sustainable mobility, transport systems, and spatial planning. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail. * Ability to work with datasets and interpret spatial information. * Good communication and organisational skills. * Familiarity with Python, SQL, spatial analytics, or geospatial data processing would be an advantage but is not essential. **Project Work / Portfolio** Candidates are encouraged to share coursework, university projects, internships, research, or personal projects demonstrating: * GIS analysis and mapping * Spatial analysis and visualisation * Urban or transport planning studies * Infrastructure or accessibility assessments * Data analysis and problem\-solving using GIS methodologies **What You’ll Gain** * Practical experience in EV infrastructure planning and network expansion. * Exposure to real\-world GIS, planning, and spatial analytics projects. * Experience working across planning, operations, and commercial teams. * Development of technical, analytical, and professional skills. * Insight into the rapidly growing EV and sustainable transport sector. **Location** Maynooth **Duration** 3 month Internship (Flexible depending on availability) Paid Internship \- €14\.15 per hour

title: Graduate Accountant (Keelings Group)
description: **About Keelings** Keelings is a 100% Irish\-owned family business passionate about fresh produce. Operating across Ireland, the UK, and Europe, we grow, source, and supply top\-quality fruit and vegetables. Our success is built on innovation, sustainability, and strong partnerships — powered by our dedicated people. **We are hiring a Graduate Accountant to start in September/October 2026\.** **Purpose of the Role** Join Keelings! You will be part of a passionate team of people and a growing business. Come on the journey with us where you will grow and develop and truly feel a sense of belonging. At Keelings, we don't just grow quality fresh produce, we also nurture people and their professional development. The Keelings family always employ the best people for the job, the key to our success is the quality of the people we employ. The successful candidate will be offered a 3/3\.5 year training contract depending on exam route with ACA. During this period, the successful candidate will gain exposure to a number of departments across the Keelings business such as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Head Office function and a Trading Business Unit. The role also offers paid study leave and exam fees, in line with CAI guidelines, leading to the ACA qualification. **Our Strategic Priorities** **Better Food** \- We make our products better and inspire more people to enjoy produce. **People** \- We support our people to learn, be at their best, contribute and deliver on their commitments, using One Keelings' standards. **Better Ways** \- Every year we improve our competitiveness, efficiency and delivery through insight, technology and One Keelings. **Better World** \- We improve our environmental and social impact to make a positive difference in our world. **Partnerships** \- Working with Keelings creates value and long\-term relationships with our customers \& suppliers. **Growth** \- We invest in and deliver insight led, focused, profitable growth into the future. **Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities** **Accounts Payable** * Matching, coding and processing of Supplier invoices to stock system * Investigation and resolution of supplier queries * Assist in preparing accounts for payment * Creditors Reconciliations monthly/quarterly working from aged accruals listing / critical supplier listing * Attend weekly meetings with the cost centre to which you are assigned to provide service to the business unit **Accounts Receivable** * Responsibility for the collection of debtor accounts across Multiples and Independent Retail accounts * Debtors reconciliations forms a large part of this role – mainly working on large supermarket accounts * Weekly debtor’s reconciliations for main debtors accounts * Daily Cash / Cheques posting/allocating from post \& BIF **Treasury** * Assist the treasury manager with managing daily liquidity * Daily cash reporting * Perform monthly bank reconciliations * Weekly bank postings **Head Office / Trading Business Unit** * Assist in month\-end accounts preparation, posting journals and reconciling accounts * Assist with year\-end audit * Preparation \& submission of Group Intrastat and VAT returns * Raising recharges to BU’s for central resources * Raising sales invoices to third parties * Reconciliations of balance sheet control accounts * Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and posting intercompany journals * Reconciliation of bank accounts \& posting cashbook and cheques journals * Analysis and recharging of group travel expenses * Control and management of petty cash * Invoice processing \& ad\-hoc payments * Any other ad hoc duties as deemed appropriate by the management team **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** **The measurement of the above will be monitored via** * Timely processing of supplier invoices and resolution of supplier queries * Timely collection of debtor accounts and monthly reconciliations * Timely submission of monthly accounts within trading business units * Monthly bank reconciliations for Treasury * Maintenance and reconciliation of Intercompany balances * Weekly, monthly and quarterly one on one reviews with reporting manager * Other KPI’s to be determined as appropriate based on various department requirements **Essential** **Key Skills \& Knowledge** * Must have level 8 or 9 qualification in a relevant discipline (graduated within the last 2 years) * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Be able to perform well under pressure in an ever\-changing environment * Highly accurate and fine attention to detail essential * Candidates must speak fluent English. title: Graduate Architect (Dublin)
description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact Join the Jacobs Graduate Development Program (GDP) and help shape better environments, communities and societies. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change. What You’ll Get Our two‑year Graduate Development Program is designed to accelerate your growth as you begin your Jacobs career. Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions. You’ll tailor your learning journey to your interests, career goals and technical strengths — creating a graduate experience that’s uniquely yours. Much of your development will come through real project work, supported by your manager and mentor to ensure you gain the experiences that matter most. The Graduate Development Program isn’t just a steppingstone — it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain the tools, exposure and support to unlock your potential, working on meaningful projects and collaborating with industry leaders to deliver solutions to complex challenges. **About The Opportunity** We’re proud to hold longstanding partnerships with the world’s leading Life Sciences firms. From designing a facility to manufacture transformative therapies, to accelerating the delivery of life\-saving products, we help our clients solve their most important challenges. Our aim is to give the best minds of today the platform to create the cures of tomorrow. As our clients work to meet aggressive timelines, we strive to be the catalyst for innovation. We provide end\-to\-end project delivery from a trusted partner in a fast, smart and safe way – on time and within budget. With more than half a century’s relevant experience to draw upon, this adds up to a total one\-stop facility service for our clients. The start date for this position is September 2027\. Here's what you'll need * Be working towards a relevant Degree or Master’s level qualification in Architecture * A flexible, proactive mindset and motivation to drive your career forward * Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning * Permanent right to work in Ireland Selection Process * Apply Online * Solo Video Assessment * Interview Apply before 12 October 2026 to be considered in the first assessment window. Applications may still be accepted afterwards, but roles may be filled during the initial window. For further information, please see our brochure \- https//jacobs\-global.foleon.com/brochures/early\-careers/ \#EarlyCareersUK \#GraduateUK \#GraduateJob2027 \#GraduateCareersUK \#GraduaterecruitmentUK \#GraduateJobsUK \#GraduateopportunitiesUK Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well\-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs. We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here. Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles. As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role. We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Graduate Audit Trainee (ACCA) - Dublin - September 2027
description: Opportunity Graduate Location Dublin Opportunity details **Your future starts here** Are you looking to start your career in Audit, helping businesses build confidence in their financial reporting and decision\-making? We’re seeking ambitious individuals from all backgrounds to join our team as a trainee, studying towards the ACCA qualification. **Who we are** Saffery is a partner\-led and people\-focused firm of chartered accountants, tax and business advisers. Since 1855, we’ve built long\-term relationships with our diverse, high\-profile clients, across varied and specialised sectors. As a proud member of Nexia, a worldwide network of trusted member firms, we’ve got access to local insight on a global scale. We pride ourselves on our informal and inclusive culture, building an environment where people can be themselves and enjoy challenging, interesting, rewarding careers. When you work with Saffery, the well\-respected accountancy firm where heritage meets ambition, you work with people who know your name. Who know you as a human being, not just a job title. Everyone belongs here. Always. **Who we welcome** We recognise that talent comes from different paths, so we encourage applications from recent graduates or career changers. We do not expect applicants to have any prior relevant work experience. **Ready to start your journey?** Explore life at Saffery \& apply today: Life at Saffery **About the team** The Film, TV \& Video Games team works with a diverse range of clients across the creative industries, including film and television production companies, video game developers, major studios, streaming platforms and specialist service providers. Clients range from owner\-managed businesses and independent producers to large multinational organisations. The team provides audit, tax and advisory services, supporting clients operating in a dynamic and fast\-evolving sector. **About the programme** Our training contract takes three years to complete with full support and access to first\-class tuition centres. You’ll follow a structured development programme combining professional study with on\-the\-job learning. As your knowledge and confidence grow, you’ll take on more responsibility within audit engagements, contribute to more complex areas of work and build your confidence working directly with clients. If you’reAAT Level 4 qualified, you will be eligible for exemptions, otherwise we ask for all trainees to complete the full ACCA syllabus. We believe that studying alongside a cohort gives you the best chance of exam success. **Key dates to apply:** Monday 14 September 2026 \- Sunday 4 October 2026 We encourage early applications to avoid disappointment, as roles may close early due to high demand. Due to the volume of applications, you may occasionally experience delays; however, we remain committed to reviewing all applications fairly. All applications are assessed by trained human reviewers, and automated tools are not used to make final decisions. **Your role and development** Your growthdoesn't just come from exams. It comes from valuable work experience and real\-world learning. **What you’ll do** * You'll be taken through the various stages of an audit from planning to completion * Support audit engagements for clients across a diverse range of industries by testing financial information and reviewing key controls * Prepare clear, well\-structured audit documentation and working papers * Work with client financial data using a range of accounting systems and audit tools * Assist with planning and fieldwork * Build strong relationships with clients to gain a deeper understanding of their business * Help identify and investigate differences or inconsistencies in financial information * Work closely with colleagues to deliver high\-quality audit work to agreed deadlines **What you’ll learn** * Core audit and accounting principles, including regulatory and reporting requirements * How audits are planned, delivered and reviewed in practice * How businesses operate and how their financial processes and controls work * How to assess risk and evaluate financial information critically * The practical application of your professional qualification studies in a real\-world environment We’ll support you every step of the way through mentorship, structured training, and our off\-site trainee programmes as well as regular social events to build friendships with colleagues. **What you'll need** * This role requires employees to be a tax resident in the Republic of Ireland, * 2:1 undergraduate degree (expected or obtained) in any discipline, * A minimum of 400 Leaving Certificate points or 120 UCAS points from your top 3 A Levels or Highers (or equivalent), excluding General Studies and AS Levels, * A minimum of B (or equivalent) in GCSE, National 5 or Junior Certificate Maths and English Language. We welcome applications from candidates who are AAT qualified. If you have completed AAT studies (up to Level 4\) in place of A Levels or Highers, please detail this under the A Level or Scottish Highers (or equivalent) qualifications section on your application form. If you have over 12 months relevant experience within a training contract at another firm, we recommend exploring part\-qualified opportunities on our Experienced Hire vacancy page. We understand that confidence plays a role in job applications, and some candidates may hesitate to apply. If this role excites you and aligns with your career ambitions, we’d love to hear from you! **Where potential meets personal meets you** At Saffery, we look for people who share our values. We're looking for individuals who are **collaborative, responsible, progressive** and act with **integrity**, whilst always striving for **excellence**. You'll be approachable, committed and ready to take ownership of your work, with a proactive and curious mindset and a genuine interest in how businesses operate. We value people who are organised, pay close attention to detail, enjoy working with financial data, and can manage their time effectively. You'll thrive in a close\-knit team environment, working collaboratively with others while taking responsibility for your own development. We want people who are willing to learn, ask questions, speak up when something could be better, and help make improvements happen. Here, you're never just a number. We value drive, focus and a positive attitude, but we also value who you are as a person. We believe in caring more, leaving egos behind, supporting each other and enjoying the journey together. There's genuine mutual respect here and a two\-way relationship where we bring out the best in each other. We’ll help you get to know our clients, but we also look for people who are naturally inquisitive about the wider business and economic landscape. If you're curious, eager to learn, and committed to giving your best, you'll find plenty of support and opportunities to succeed as you work towards your qualification and beyond. You’ll be surrounded by people who value you, your contributions, and your potential. **What we’ll offer you** We believe thatsupporting our people leads to success, so we provide both core and flexible benefits tailored to your needs: **Financial support \& flexibility** * Competitive salary * Profit\-sharing scheme (approx. €1,000 per year) * Generous annual leave \& flexible work arrangements * Contributory pension plan (5% salary match) **Work life balance \& wellbeing** * Buddy scheme and/or line manager support * Agile working policy (up to three days working from home, however in your first few months we do encourage up to 4 days in the office to reap the benefits of training around your managers and colleagues) * Health assessments, GP access, \& cancer screenings * Access to mental health \& wellbeing resources **Personal development and belonging** * Mentorship \& career progression opportunities * Participation in our Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion (ED\&I) programme * Volunteer to join one of our People networks, including Accessibility, Cultural Heritage, Faith, LGBTQ\+, Social Mobility and Gender Equality **What to know before you apply** * Before submitting your application, take some time to familiarise yourself with our recruitment process by visiting How to apply \- Saffery. Through this page you can also navigate to guidance on how to appropriately use AI in your application. * We also recommend practising psychometric tests and learning more about how to approach a face\-to\-face, competency\-based interview. This will help you feel confident and prepared to show your best self. * You can apply to just one of our programmes during each recruitment season. If your application isn’t successful this time, we’d love for you to try again when applications re\-open next September for the following year. * If you’ve experienced extenuating circumstances (such as bereavement, mental health challenges, or any other unforeseen situation), that may have impacted your academic performance, please reach out to us before you submit an application \- EarlyCareersTalent@saffery.com. * If you require any reasonable adjustments, please look out for further details throughout our assessment process on how to request throughout each stage of our application and assessment process. We’re committed to assessing all applicants fairly and want to do everything we can to support your success throughout the process. * If you are selected for an in\-person interview, we will provide reimbursement for your travel expenses. More information on what we cover will be shared at this stage of the process. * If you're offered a place at Saffery, we kindly recommend holding off on booking any annual leave around your expected start date. This helps ensure you don’t miss out on important training and onboarding sessions that will set you up for success.

Join us. **Job Description** We have an exciting opportunity in Dublin, Ireland, for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Highways, Active Travel and Infrastructure team of more than 150\+staff. AECOM are recognised as market leaders in highways, public transport and active travel. The team continues to deliver high\-profile and impactful projects across the island of Ireland. Based in our growing Dublin team, you’ll work within a positive and collaborative environment alongside experienced engineers and a locally based senior management team. title: Graduate Commercial Sales Trainee
description: · **Industry leading graduate sales opportunity with Edmundson Electrical** · **€32,000 basic salary \+ lucrative profit share scheme** · **No experience needed, fantastic opportunity to start your career** · **12 months rotation through various departments to give you full exposure to the business** · **Great career progression opportunities** **The Company** Edmundson Electrical are the UK's leading distributor of branded electrical equipment to trade and industry, selling over 120,000 product lines and employing over 4000 staff across 400 locations throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland. A fast\-growing company with a long history of training and developing people in both sales and managerial roles, Edmundson are now seeking to continue their success by adding entry level talent into their teams. **The Role** Edmundson Electrical are looking to recruit, train and develop ambitious graduates to be based out of any of their 400 independently run profit centres across the UK and Ireland. As a Graduate Sales Trainee at Edmundson, you will be educated on both the company, their products and the market they sell into. Receiving continuous 'on the job' training, the graduate will also have the opportunity to receive professional sales training to equip them with all the tools and skills needed to flourish in a successful sales career. ***Progression opportunities into External Sales and then potentially Profit Centre Management in the future.*** · **Obtain a comprehensive knowledge of the business as you spend time training within different functions** · **Develop into an external, customer facing sales role after around 12 months** · **Identify and develop new business opportunities from new customers and dormant/lapsed accounts** · **Gain thorough product knowledge to be competent and effective when dealing with customers and promoting the benefits of using Edmundson Electrical as a supplier of choice** · **Chase down leads, influence, negotiate and generate sales over the phone and in person** **As a Graduate Commercial Trainee, the package you will receive is:** · €32,000 basic salary · Eligibility for lucrative company profit share scheme · Incentivised learning (bonus opportunity upon completion of training) · 25 days holiday plus bank holidays · Extensive professional sales training \- fully funded and accredited · Auto\-enrolment into the Company's contributory pension scheme **Requirements for this role:** · Fantastic verbal and written communication Skills · Full, clean driving license · Strong work ethic and a team player who can also work well on their own initiative · This role requires you to work an occasional Saturday morning as the business trades 6 days a week · You have finished studying and are ready for an immediate start! **What you will do: First 6 months** · Learn a lot! · Based in a branch \- you will start your training in a warehouse learning about the products, operating procedures, understanding the market, customers and suppliers. · You will then work your way through various departments including the trade counter to develop the skills needed for long term success. · Around month 3 you will start selling. Calling lapsed/dormant accounts and self\-sourcing new accounts · Begin your industry leading sales training programme through BMS; designed to give you the skill set and structures to be successful and confident in your role. · Develop the imperative skills to further your career in sales **Next 6\-12 months** · Consistently start bringing in sales and revenue · Begin to learn and understand the full sales process · Further develop a relationship with more senior sales colleagues to gain an understanding of the potential next step in your career · Continue to develop and grow in confidence and ability with BMS sales training. **Next 12 months and onwards** · Move out of the Graduate Sales Trainee role · Work towards sales targets · Become an essential part of the external sales team out in the field · Further career development opportunities into management exist for those who can demonstrate success and ability to develop long lasting customer relationships *All applications are going to be managed directly by BMS Performance, market leaders in graduate recruitment.*

Join us. **Job Description** Our Ground Engineering team in the United Kingdom and Ireland (UK\&I) comprises 150 professionals who provide a comprehensive range of services, including project management, feasibility studies, ground investigation design and interpretation, detailed design, contract administration, and construction supervision. We work on ground engineering projects across the UK\&I and internationally, supporting both internal and external clients. Our primary focus areas include energy, water, nuclear (decommissioning and new build), power, road and rail, aviation, ports and harbours, as well as commercial and industrial developments, and landslip investigation and remediation. We work for leading UK and International clients, including National Grid, BP, Sellafield, Associated British Ports, Transport Scotland, National Highways, Transport Infrastructure Ireland, Network Rail, and local authorities, as well as for prominent contractors and developers. Geotechnical Engineering and Engineering Geology graduates at AECOM will work on a range of projects, involving work such as: * Desk studies, site inspections, rockface surveys and geomorphological mapping. * Design, planning and procurement of ground investigations. * Supervision of ground investigation fieldwork. * Geological interpretation and preparation of interpretative reports. * Analysis of geotechnical data, preparation of ground models, design and reporting of ground engineering solutions, including foundations, retaining walls, soil slope stability, earthworks and rock slope stabilisation measures. * Use of cutting\-edge digital software, including Openground for ground investigation data management and Leapfrog for 3D geological modelling * Access to a range of 2D and 3D numerical analysis software packages, with opportunities for candidates interested in developing analysis and modelling skills. **Qualifications** * A degree in Civil Engineering or Engineering Geology/Geology, with a 2:1 classification (or equivalent) or higher. * An MSc/MEng in Soil Mechanics, Geotechnical Engineering or Engineering Geology is advantageous. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential, and competent use of AutoCAD/Civil 3D software is desirable. * Candidates with prior ground engineering work experience are preferred, though this is not essential. * Willingness and ability to work towards professional qualifications through the ICE, IOM3 or The Geological Society. * Demonstrated interest in ground engineering projects and in promoting ground engineering activities with clients. * Flexibility to work away from home on sites and occasionally in other offices. * Full UK driving license preferred. * Motivated to meet client and business expectations, with an understanding of the wider financial and commercial implications of project delivery. * Effective communicator with colleagues, internal / external clients, both verbally and in writing. * Ability to structure and prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the team. * Capacity to work independently without losing initiative and focus. **Additional Information** * a covering letter with your application, detailing all predicted and/or obtained academic grades, the dates you are able to work (to/from), and the locations you are interested in. * We support and encourage office attendance across all grades to foster a collaborative working culture and facilitate on\-the\-job learning for early career staff. * You must have the right to work in the UK. the world we live in. title: Graduate Programme - Store Layouts, In-Store Experience & Technology
description: **Summary** From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl. We’re big on growth, and we give you all the support, structure, and hands\-on experience you need to level up both personally and professionally. As the **only City \& Guilds/ILM Accredited Graduate Programme in Ireland** , our 18\-month Graduate Management Development Programme is built entirely around *you* . **What makes it different?** * Tailored To You: Enjoy a bespoke training plan mapped to your unique skills and long\-term career goals. * Real\-World Experience: Get stuck into our stores and distribution centers to learn the heart of our business from the ground up. * Blended Learning: Experience dynamic, structured on\-the\-job training combined with industry\-leading modules. We don't just hire graduates—we build future leaders. Ready to launch yours? **Store Layouts, In\-Store Experience \& Technology** Ready to shape the future of retail? Sales graduates will gain experience in two distinct teams within the Sales Head Office Department: Store Layouts \& Experience and Sales Systems \& Solutions. The Sales department is focussed on in\-store experience and technology and is responsible for improving how millions of customers shop and navigate in our 230\+ stores.
