title: Graduate Project Engineer
description: **Job Title:** Graduate Project Engineer **Reporting to:** Project Manager **Business Unit:** Republic of Ireland As a specialized subsidiary of VINCI Energies, Omexom acts as an EPC contractor (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) to offer turnkey solutions for the design, supply, installation, maintenance, and commissioning of electrical infrastructures for a varied range of electricity utility companies and renewable energy developers throughout the UK and Ireland. The current team aims to strengthen its skills and demonstrate its commitment to early career engineers by offering a graduate programme that includes both specialized learning and a comprehensive view of the activity. As part of the development of our activities in Ireland, we are recruiting for graduates to join us for an initial 2\-year placement programme. **Role Purpose** The successful applicant will work under the guidance of experienced Engineers and Project Managers, gaining hands\-on experience across civil, mechanical, and electrical disciplines while developing the technical and leadership skills required for their future career. The Graduate Project Engineer will provide support to the Project Manager for our electricity substation/Renewables operational teams, serving as the main support function, ensuring effective information flow, identifying design risks, and making sure that design outputs comply with Works Information and technical standards. The Graduate Project Engineer collaborates closely with design engineers, planners, document controllers, commercial teams, and project managers. They help manage the program, documentation, meetings, and design interfaces to ensure successful project delivery. The role may require regular travel across the island of Ireland, and the UK, to visit various project sites as required. **Responsibilities \& Duties** Including but not limited to the following: **1\. Data Analysis and D\&E Programme Updates** * Assist the Design Delivery Manager in maintaining the D\&E Management Report using the Project Deliverables Tracker. * Help the Design Delivery Manager in updating the Project Weekly and Monthly reports based on the D\&E Management Report. * Gather and analyse data from various sources. * Monitor deliverables, including incoming items, internal reviews, and submissions. * Assist in developing and updating the D\&E Programme. **2\. Design Assurance \& Documentation Management** * Prepare meeting minutes. * Support compliance checking against standards and governance processes. **3\. Change, TQs \& RFI Management** * Maintain registers for Design Changes, Early Warnings (EWNs), Compensation Events (CEs), Project Manager Instructions (PMIs), Technical Queries (TQs) and Request for Information (RFIs). * Ensure correct routing of technical queries between teams. * Provide early warning of potential issues to the Design Delivery Manager. **4\. Interface \& Communication** * Act as a link between Design Engineers and Design Delivery Manager. * Support stakeholder communication, document control and coordination. * Assist in ensuring design intent is communicated clearly to construction teams. **5\. Risk \& Safety Support** * Support the Design Delivery Manager in identifying and documenting design risks. * Ensure CDM 2015 Regulations compliance data is captured and stored appropriately. **6\. Team \& Improvement Contribution** * Promote collaboration and cross\-disciplinary coordination. * Support lessons learned collection and dissemination. **Key Interfaces** Relationships with key stakeholders: * Design Delivery Manager. * Design Teams (internal and external). * Project Managers. * Planning Team. * Client Representatives. **Person Specification** **Qualifications and Experience** The jobholder shall hold a degree in a relevant discipline, preferably in Electrical Engineering. They should also possess; * Excellent team ethic, and ability to work on your own initiative. * Ability to communicate with people at all levels, both internally and externally, developing positive relationships with customers through good professional conduct. * Ability to work accurately and methodically under pressure and strict deadlines, including the ability to juggle multiple tasks. * Time and cost management skills to ensure cost\-effective and accurate delivery. * Effectively manage own time across multiple tasks and prioritise workload. * Ability to work well within a team of other professionals in delivering designs to satisfy the Scope of Works. **Essential** * Mandatory Omexom training courses. * Full ROI Driving Licence. **Desirable** * CIGRE / IEEE / IET Membership. **Competencies** Required skills, knowledge, and abilities: * Computer Programming Skills (Python Language, Visual Basic for Applications, Matlab). * Computer\-Aided Design Skills (AutoCAD). * Prompt Engineering Skills for Large Language Models (LLMs). * Detail\-oriented mindset. * Ability to put the customer at the centre of decision making. * Commitment to the highest safety and quality\-related standards. **Values** In line with Omexom’s values, the jobholder must have the following qualities: * **Team Spirit \& Generosity** – able to work effectively within and contribute to the Omexom team to deliver results, provide support and drive performance. * **Trust and Empowerment** – enjoy managing their responsibilities and time to ensure work is completed efficiently and professionally. * **Integrity and Responsibility** – enjoy taking responsibility for their duties and managing these effectively to ensure efficient high quality results. * **Innovation \& Entrepreneurship** – continually strive to improve processes and introduce new initiatives to improve efficiency.

title: Graduate Tax Trainee (ACCA) - Dublin - September 2027
description: Opportunity Graduate Location Dublin Opportunity details **Your future starts here** Are you looking to start your career in Tax, helping individuals and businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax landscape? We’re seeking ambitious individuals from all backgrounds to join our team as a trainee, studying towards the ACCA qualification. **Who we are** Saffery is a partner\-led and people\-focused firm of chartered accountants, tax and business advisers. Since 1855, we’ve built long\-term relationships with our diverse, high\-profile clients, across varied and specialised sectors. As a proud member of Nexia, a worldwide network of trusted member firms, we’ve got access to local insight on a global scale. We pride ourselves on our informal and inclusive culture, building an environment where people can be themselves and enjoy challenging, interesting, rewarding careers. When you work with Saffery, the well\-respected accountancy firm where heritage meets ambition, you work with people who know your name. Who know you as a human being, not just a job title. Everyone belongs here. Always. **Who we welcome** We recognise that talent comes from different paths, so we encourage applications from recent graduates or career changers. We do not expect applicants to have any prior relevant work experience. **Ready to start your journey?** Explore life at Saffery \& apply today: Life at Saffery **About the team** Our tax team deals with a large portfolio of corporate and private clients. You will be working in a fast\-paced environment on tax advisory and compliance services. Our team are leading advisors in Ireland to the film and TV industry, and you will work with large Irish independent producers as well as Hollywood studios and streaming service providers. In addition, we do significant work in the Irish digital gaming sector, and R\&D tax credits. This is an exciting time to join our team which is expanding rapidly. **About the programme** Our training contract takes three years to complete with full support and access to first\-class tuition centres. You’ll follow a structured development programme combining professional study with on\-the\-job learning. As your knowledge and confidence develop, you’ll take on more complex work, contribute to projects and build your expertise as a trusted advisor. If you’reAAT Level 4 qualified, you will be eligible for exemptions, otherwise we ask for all trainees to complete the fullACCA syllabus. We believe that studying alongside a cohort gives you the best chance of exam success. **Key dates to apply:** Monday 14 September 2026 \- Sunday 4 October 2026 We encourage early applications to avoid disappointment, as roles may close early due to high demand. Due to the volume of applications, you may occasionally experience delays; however, we remain committed to reviewing all applications fairly. All applications are assessed by trained human reviewers, and automated tools are not used to make final decisions. **Your role and development** Your growthdoesn't just come from exams. It comes from valuable work experience and real\-world learning. **What you’ll do** * Assist with the preparation of tax returns, computations and other compliance filings for a range of clients. * Support tax advisory and compliance work by carrying out technical research, preparing calculations and reports, and assisting with client projects and queries. * Work with financial and client data, using specialist software and systems to deliver accurate, high\-quality tax services. * Gain exposure to a broad range of domestic and international clients, including high\-net\-worth individuals, family offices and businesses operating in the film, TV and gaming sectors. * Learn about Irish tax incentives and reliefs, including those relevant to the creative industries, while supporting advisory projects and tax planning discussions. * Build relationships with clients and colleagues, contributing to practical solutions that help clients meet their tax obligations and achieve their goals. **What you’ll learn** * Core tax principles, legislation and regulatory requirements. * How tax rules apply to different clients and business situations. * How to analyse financial information and prepare tax returns, calculations and technical documentation. * The role tax plays in compliance, advisory work and business decision\-making. * How to communicate technical information effectively. * The practical application of your professional qualification studies in a real\-world environment. * Corporate and personal tax compliance, reporting and tax planning opportunities. We’ll support you every step of the way through mentorship, structured training, and our off\-site trainee programmes as well as regular social events to build friendships with colleagues. **What you'll need** * This role requires employees to be a tax resident in the Republic of Ireland. * 2:1 undergraduate degree (expected or obtained) in any discipline, * A minimum of 400 Leaving Certificate points or 120 UCAS points from your top 3 A Levels or Highers (or equivalent), excluding General Studies and AS Levels, * A minimum of B (or equivalent) in GCSE, National 5 or Junior Certificate Maths and English Language. We welcome applications from candidates who are AAT qualified. If you have completed AAT studies (up to Level 4\) in place of A Levels or Highers, please detail this under the A Level, Scottish Highers (or equivalent) qualifications section on your application form. If you have over 12 months relevant experience within a training contract at another firm, we recommend exploring part\-qualified opportunities on our Experienced Hire vacancy page. We understand that confidence plays a role in job applications, and some candidates may hesitate to apply. If this role excites you and aligns with your career ambitions, we’d love to hear from you! **Where potential meets personal meets you** At Saffery, we look for people who share our values. We're looking for individuals who are **collaborative, responsible, progressive** and act with **integrity**, whilst always striving for **excellence**. You'll be approachable, committed and ready to take ownership of your work, with a proactive and curious mindset and a genuine interest in how businesses operate. We value people who are organised, pay close attention to detail, enjoy working with financial data, and can manage their time effectively. You'll thrive in a close\-knit team environment, working collaboratively with others while taking responsibility for your own development. We want people who are willing to learn, ask questions, speak up when something could be better, and help make improvements happen. Here, you're never just a number. We value drive, focus and a positive attitude, but we also value who you are as a person. We believe in caring more, leaving egos behind, supporting each other and enjoying the journey together. There's genuine mutual respect here and a two\-way relationship where we bring out the best in each other. We’ll help you get to know our clients, but we also look for people who are naturally inquisitive about the wider business and economic landscape. If you're curious, eager to learn, and committed to giving your best, you'll find plenty of support and opportunities to succeed as you work towards your qualification and beyond. You’ll be surrounded by people who value you, your contributions, and your potential. **What we’ll offer you** We believe thatsupporting our people leads to success, so we provide both core and flexible benefits tailored to your needs: **Financial support \& flexibility** * Competitive salary * Profit\-sharing scheme (approx. €1,000 per year) * Generous annual leave \& flexible work arrangements * Contributory pension plan (5% salary match) **Work life balance \& wellbeing** * Buddy scheme and/or line manager support * Agile working policy (up to three days working from home, however in your first few months we do encourage up to 4 days in the office to reap the benefits of training around your managers and colleagues) * Health assessments, GP access, \& cancer screenings * Access to mental health \& wellbeing resources **Personal development and belonging** * Mentorship \& career progression opportunities * Participation in our Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion (ED\&I) programme * Volunteer to join one of our People networks, including Accessibility, Cultural Heritage, Faith, LGBTQ\+, Social Mobility and Gender Equality **What to know before you apply** * Before submitting your application, take some time to familiarise yourself with our recruitment process by visiting How to apply \- Saffery. Through this page you can also navigate to guidance on how to appropriately use AI in your application. * We also recommend practising psychometric tests and learning more about how to approach a face\-to\-face, competency\-based interview. This will help you feel confident and prepared to show your best self. * You can apply to just one of our programmes during each recruitment season. If your application isn’t successful this time, we’d love for you to try again when applications re\-open next September for the following year. * If you’ve experienced extenuating circumstances (such as bereavement, mental health challenges, or any other unforeseen situation), that may have impacted your academic performance, please reach out to us before you submit an application \- EarlyCareersTalent@saffery.com. * If you require any reasonable adjustments, please look out for further details throughout our assessment process on how to request throughout each stage of our application and assessment process. We’re committed to assessing all applicants fairly and want to do everything we can to support your success throughout the process. * If you are selected for an in\-person interview, we will provide reimbursement for your travel expenses. More information on what we cover will be shared at this stage of the process. * If you're offered a place at Saffery, we kindly recommend holding off on booking any annual leave around your expected start date. This helps ensure you don’t miss out on important training and onboarding sessions that will set you up for success.

title: HR Administrator
description: **The Vacancy** **About The Company** At Nicholas O'Dwyer, sustainability is at the core of our work. If you are looking to advance your career in a socially responsible company, which has a proven track record over 90 years, and is committed to creating a sustainable planet, we invite you to be part of our team. Our mission is to provide innovative and reliable solutions using cutting edge technology and expertise, to ensure project success and employee satisfaction. We deliver infrastructure projects in water, wastewater, transportation, civil and structural engineering, flood protection, and energy including renewables. With headquarters in Ireland, we also operate in the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. As part of the RSK Group, an amalgamation of over 200 companies with more than 17,000 employees, we benefit from a global network of opportunities while retaining our brand and autonomy. **About The Role** This entry\-level HR role offers hands\-on experience across key areas of Human Resources, supporting recruitment, employee engagement, and HR operations while developing foundational skills within our HR Department. The role requires a high level of attention to detail, discretion when handling confidential information, and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment. **Key Duties And Responsibilities** The following outlines the key responsibilities of the position. This list is not exhaustive and may evolve to meet business requirements: * Maintain and update employee records and HR Department databases, ensuring all relevant documentation is accurately captured and filed. * Assist with the administration of employment permit, visa and immigration processes. * Track and follow up on pre\-employment screening activities, including references and right\-to\-work documentation. * Support onboarding activities, including issuing pre\-employment communications and coordinating induction programmes, internal system updates. * Assist with offboarding processes, including resignation administration, system notifications to Payroll and IT, and exit interview coordination. * Prepare and issue employee correspondence as required, including employment verification letters and other HR documentation. * Process and record employee changes including contractual amendments, reporting line changes, promotions, and role transfers. * Attend occasional department meetings and record meeting minutes, actions, and follow\-up items. * Ensure employee information is managed in accordance with GDPR and company data protection requirements. * Monitor probation review schedules, performance review dates, and other employee lifecycle milestones. * Support employee engagement initiatives, internal HR communications, EDI programmes, and cultural awareness activities. * Provide day\-to\-day administrative support to the HR Department. * Act as a first point of contact for employee queries, directing colleagues to the appropriate policies, systems, or support channels. * Assist with HR Department projects including reporting, audits and data quality initiatives. * Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance HR Department processes and ways of working. * Support annual review cycles, system updates, mail merges, contractual updates, and associated administration. * Participate fully in all training and development activities required to perform the role effectively. * Undertake additional duties and responsibilities as reasonably required to support the evolving needs of the business. **Key Requirements** * A third\-level qualification in Human Resources, Business, Administration or a related discipline, or be working towards an equivalent qualification. * Previous administrative, customer service or office\-based experience would be advantageous but is not essential. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, Word and PowerPoint. * Strong attention to detail, with a high degree of accuracy and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality. * Excellent organisational and administrative skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * The ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment. * A positive, proactive and employee\-focused approach. * A strong willingness to learn and develop within the HR profession. * The ability to work independently, use initiative and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. * A high level of integrity, professionalism and discretion. * An approachable manner and a genuine interest in supporting employees and contributing to a positive employee experience. * The ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues across all levels of the business. * A flexible and adaptable approach to changing priorities and business requirements. * Experience using HR information systems or databases would be advantageous but is not essential. * An understanding of GDPR and the importance of protecting confidential employee information would be advantageous. * Motivation to work for an organisation with a clear purpose of improving communities and quality of life through sustainable engineering solutions. **About Us** Our mission is to deliver sustainable solutions that transform communities and bring about lasting positive change. Through a blend of expertise, innovation and global dedication, we envision a world where sustainable engineering protects growing communities. Nicholas O’Dwyer provides professional services in engineering design, project management, environment and planning, construction supervision and technical and contract advisory. We are one of the most respected Irish consultancies operating in local and international markets, providing professional services to public\- and private\-sector clients. title: Indaver International Graduate Program (IIGP)
description: **What will your working day look like?** First things first—apply! We’re excited to hear from you. Send us your application, and we’ll carefully review it. Your journey begins with your first assignment, where you’ll gain hands\-on experience and start developing your personal growth plan. geometric design, and the preparation of engineering drawings using industry\-standard software. * Supporting the assessment and development of highway improvement schemes from feasibility through to detailed design. * Assisting with the preparation of technical reports, specifications, drawings, and other project documentation. * Working with engineers to analyse technical information, survey present ideas clearly to colleagues and project stakeholders. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. * Strong attention to detail, with good research, technical writing, and report\-writing skills. * A self\-motivated and enthusiastic approach, with a willingness to learn new software, tools, and technical methodologies. **Additional At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM. **Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity** You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too. Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours. We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme. title: Junior AV Installation Engineer
description: Role overview AVITUC is seeking a practical junior engineer to support the installation and commissioning of audio visual systems at customer sites across Ireland. The role suits someone beginning an AV career who is comfortable using tools, learning technical systems and working as part of a field team. Main responsibilities · Assist with the installation of displays, projectors, speakers, microphones, cameras, control equipment and structured cabling. · Follow drawings, cable schedules, method statements and instructions from senior engineers. · Label, test and document cables and installed equipment. · Support basic configuration and commissioning of meeting room and presentation systems. · Maintain safe, tidy work areas and protect customer premises during installation. · Record completed work, issues and equipment details accurately. Essential requirements · An interest in audio visual technology, electronics, electrical work or a related technical trade. · Practical ability with hand tools and a willingness to learn installation standards. · Clear communication, reliability and a professional manner with customers. · A valid driving licence and willingness to travel to customer sites across Ireland. · Permission to work in Ireland. Useful additional experience · Previous experience with AV, electrical, data cabling or construction projects. · Familiarity with Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, interactive displays or digital signage. · A relevant apprenticeship, certificate or technical qualification. What success looks like · Installations are completed safely, neatly and in line with the project plan. · Equipment and cables are labelled and documented correctly. · The engineer develops the skills to complete standard installation tasks with decreasing supervision. Working arrangements and benefits · Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:30pm; based from Tallaght. Most work is in Dublin and Belfast, with travel across Ireland. · Annual leave starts at 20 days, rises by one day per completed year to 25 days, and includes Good Friday. A phone, laptop and auto\-enrolment pension are provided; a company vehicle may be available where required. · Other benefits include mental health, sick and miscarriage leave under company policy; quarterly training; three to four social events; meal subsistence outside Leinster; and company\-paid accommodation for occasional overnight assignments. How to apply * Email your CV and a short note on your relevant experience to avituclimited@gmail.com, for the attention of Will McConnell. Use the role title as the email subject.

title: Junior Business Developer
description: We are looking for a driven, curious and resilient Business Development Representative to join our growing sales team. As the engine of our new\-business pipeline, you'll be the first point of contact for prospective customers \- researching target accounts, opening conversations through outbound outreach, and uncovering opportunities for our Google Cloud and Google Workspace solutions. Working closely with our sales team and CEO, you'll play a key role in generating qualified pipeline and fuelling the company's growth. **What You'll Do** ● Prospect Proactively: Research and identify target accounts and decision\-makers, building your own list of qualified prospects across your territory. ● Open Conversations: Run multi\-channel outreach \- cold calling, email sequences and LinkedIn/social \- to spark interest and secure meetings for the sales team. ● Qualify Opportunities: Understand each prospect's challenges and goals, positioning Damson Cloud's solutions to uncover genuine opportunities worth pursuing. ● Generate Pipeline: Consistently create and grow qualified pipeline value \- your primary measure of success \- feeding a healthy flow of new business. ● Collaborate Closely: Work hand\-in\-hand with the sales team and CEO to refine messaging, share market insight and hand over well\-qualified opportunities. ● Track Everything: Keep accurate records of your activity and prospects in our CRM (HubSpot), using the data to sharpen your approach and support sales strategy. **Who You Are** ● A Hunter: You get a genuine buzz from opening new doors and chasing opportunities. Rejection doesn't knock you off course \- it sharpens your focus. ● A Self\-Starter: You take ownership from day one, set your own pace and don't wait to be told what to do next. ● Self\-Motivated \& Positive: You bring energy and a can\-do attitude to every day, staying resilient and upbeat through the ups and downs of outbound sales. ● Curious About Technology: You're fascinated by cloud and AI, and eager to keep learning how these tools solve real business problems. ● Built for Remote: You thrive in a fully remote setting \- disciplined, self\-directed and a strong communicator who stays connected with the team from anywhere. **Key Skills** ● Experience: Around 1 year in an outbound sales, BDR/SDR or lead\-generation role \- or the equivalent energy and drive to learn how to do it. ● Outbound Skills: A confident cold caller and strong written communicator, comfortable running email and LinkedIn outreach and handling early objections. ● Commercial Curiosity: Genuinely interested in customers' businesses, with the resilience and persistence that outbound prospecting requires. ● Technical Awareness: General cloud, SaaS or AI knowledge is a distinct advantage; a willingness to learn Google Cloud and Google Workspace is essential. ● Proactive Mindset: Highly motivated, organised and self\-directed, with a track record of hitting targets and managing your own workload. ● Systems Knowledge: Comfortable using CRM systems to manage prospecting activity and pipeline. ● Communication: Fluency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

This will require generation/management of Requests for Information (RFI) * Assisting the Installation Package team to manage the quality needs for the project on site, providing guidance to ensure we are compliant to all relevant standards/codes and specifications associated. title: Multimedia Journalist (Podcast)
description: RTÉ is Ireland's national public\-service media organisation. We are embarking upon an ambitious and exciting 5\-year transformation strategy to update the way we run the organisation. Our mission is to serve as an independent source of stories, news, information, and entertainment for Ireland, reflecting the diversity of its people and providing experiences that enrich the lives of all. This sense of purpose motivates us to deliver to the highest standards in an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and engaging. Attracting and retaining the best talent is key in delivering to our audiences. We want our people to thrive in an environment that values their output. **RTÉ Podcasts:** RTÉ has set up a podcasting department as part of our response to rapidly changing audience behaviour and media consumption. RTÉ Podcasts was created to engage with under 45 audiences who consume an increasing amount of media on non\-linear platforms. We are creating habit\-forming podcasts which place RT É at the centre of this audience’s digital audio consumption. **About the role:** With that in mind, we are building a team of versatile, editorially brave, instinctive content creators. We are now seeking to appoint a Multimedia Journalist, initially assigned to our new Daily **Sports Podcast** . If successful in applying for this role, you will: * Perform a central role in building the sports podcast, informing its identity as it grows * Initiate and create agenda\-setting digital audio for the new RTÉ audio app and other podcast platforms * Create compelling video content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram and YouTube * Potentially appear on the podcast and write articles for RTÉ’s online platforms. * Book guests and write briefs for the podcast * Interact with people working across RTÉ in the production and promotion of RTÉ podcasts * Work with digital platforms to increase the visibility and promotion of RTÉ’s podcasts. **The successful candidate will have:** * An instinctive drive to connect with audiences and, in particular, an understanding of the younger audience that is currently underserved by RTÉ * An encyclopaedic knowledge of sport and its most compelling characters – in particular across GAA, soccer and rugby * An outstanding sense of how to tell a story, and an understanding of what makes a strong guest, topic or format idea * An ability to use images, video, audio and text to maximise the impact of RTÉ’s podcasts across a variety of platforms \- in particular on social media * An understanding of podcast formats and trends in digital audio * A readiness to learn new technologies as they emerge or become relevant to the work of the podcasting department * An ability to work constructively and positively in a fast\-moving production environment * Experience working in both video and audio will be an advantage, as will an understanding of how AI is shaping the media environment \- including both the challenges it poses and the opportunities it presents If you are interested in applying for this opportunity, please apply by submitting as **one** combined document: 1. your CV 2. an introductory statement of no more than 450 words outlining the skills, experience, and qualities you would bring to this role. This section is a mandatory part of your application. The appointment will be made on a fixed term full\-time contract for a duration of two years. The salary scale for the Multimedia Journalist salary scale from €48,525 gross pa to €75,933 gross per annum. Closing date for receipt of applications is Monday 28th September 2026\. title: Network Engineer - Test (Intern)
description: **Company Description** Arista Networks is the leader in software driven networking solutions for today’s largest Data Center (DC), Cloud, Internet/WAN, Service Provider (SP) and Campus environments. Arista has over 7500 customers ranging from the largest cloud providers, to healthcare, government, carrier, finance, education, and production web/SaaS companies. Arista's products are the foundation underpinning much of modern society's operations. Arista has ambitious plans and an unprecedented opportunity for growth and we are looking for many more engineers and designers to join us in building and innovating the world's networks. Arista is a profitable, publicly quoted company with revenues of over $2B with a culture of invention, quality, respect, and fun. One of the many attractions of joining Arista is that right from the top, Arista is an engineering company. The founders and engineering managers are all engineers who understand good software engineering and the importance of doing things right. **Job Description** Arista Networks is looking for Network Engineering Students to join our Internship Programme, helping us test the highest\-quality networking products available. You will work alongside a dedicated mentor in the Testing Team for the duration of your internship, helping us explore, find and fix bugs, while we help you build upon your existing academic knowledge and skills. You don’t need to tick every box to apply, if you’re excited about networking and willing to learn, we’d love to hear from you. **What You Will Do** * Work with your mentor to design and test network topologies, validating functionality, performance, stability and scalability of Arista's features and products. * Write and execute test plans to verify all aspects of the feature and product, ensuring comprehensive coverage. * Identify defects and validate resolution. * Conduct test plan reviews to solicit feedback and identify customer\-centric use cases. **What You Will Learn** * Networking Fundamentals: Strengthen your understanding of Network Design, Routing and Switching, IP Addressing * Networking Protocols: Gain hands\-on industry experience with Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols (TCP, UDP, IP, BGP, OSPF, STP…) and have exposure to Cloud Titans network design and cutting\-edge technologies. * Network Automation: Gain insight into how we use common scripting languages to automate various elements of our testing workflow and test at scale. * Testing Methodologies: Learn structured approaches to testing features and products across multiple areas, focussing on Functionality, Performance, Stability, Reliability, Scalability and Interoperability. * Troubleshooting Methodologies: Learn troubleshooting methodologies by actively diagnosing the issues you encounter. **Qualifications** * Pursuing a BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering or related field * Understanding of core networking protocols (but mostly just a love and aptitude for network engineering). * Familiarity with scripting (e.g. Python) * Basic understanding of the Linux operating system. * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as collaboration skills. **Additional Information** * All information provided will be kept confidential in accordance with EEO guidelines. * The candidate must be able to complete a 6\-month onsite internship working a full\-time schedule. * Candidate must be eligible to work in the Republic of Ireland (no work VISA sponsored)

description: **About Albany Beck** Albany Beck is an award\-winning consultancy specialising in Technology, Risk and Compliance primarily within Financial Services. We work with top tier Investment Banks, Asset Management firms, Hedge Funds and FinTechs. **Client Deployment Role Description** Albany Beck is seeking Junior Screening Analysts to support a critical Financial Crime remediation programme with a leading organisation in Ireland. The client has identified a screening issue which has resulted in a significant backlog of alerts requiring investigation and resolution. As part of a focused remediation initiative, successful candidates will support the review and clearance of screening alerts across sanctions, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and adverse media screening. This is an excellent opportunity for analysts with approximately 1\+ years of screening experience to gain exposure to a large\-scale remediation programme while working alongside an established Financial Crime team. The initial engagement will be for three months, with the potential for extension depending on programme progress and business requirements. **Key Responsibilities** * Review and investigate sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening alerts. * Analyse customer information against watchlist data to assess potential matches. * Determine whether alerts represent genuine matches or false positives. * Document clear and concise rationale for screening decisions. * Escalate potential positive matches in accordance with established procedures. * Conduct additional research and gather supporting information where required. * Maintain accurate records of all investigations and outcomes. * Support the timely reduction of the client’s screening alert backlog. * Ensure all work is completed in line with regulatory and internal policy requirements. * Collaborate closely with Financial Crime, Compliance and Operations stakeholders. **Key Skills \& Experience** * Experience working within Financial Crime, AML or Compliance functions. * Approximately 1\+ years of hands\-on screening experience. * Practical knowledge of: * Sanctions Screening * PEP Screening * Adverse Media Screening * Experience investigating alerts and documenting outcomes. * Strong analytical and investigative skills. * Excellent attention to detail and decision\-making ability. * Strong written communication and case documentation skills. * Ability to work efficiently within a structured process\-driven environment. * Comfortable working with Excel\-based case management and reporting data. **Desirable Experience** * Experience within retail banking, payments, fintech or regulated financial services environments. * Exposure to AML, KYC, CDD or EDD processes. * Experience supporting remediation, lookback or backlog\-clearing exercises. * Knowledge of financial crime regulations and screening best practices. * Previous experience working on high\-volume alert review activities.

Please understand that due to the large number of applications, we regret that only online applications can be considered. Please click apply to submit your application. **About Pandora** Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high\-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self\-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030\. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32\.5 billion (EUR 4\.4 billion) in 2025\.

title: Social Media Content Creator
description: About DRENCH™ DRENCH™ is a fast\-growing Irish paint brand with an ambitious goal: to build one of the most recognisable and engaging paint and home\-improvement brands across Ireland and the UK. We manufacture our own range of paints, including **DRENCH All\-in\-One** , designed for use across 25\+ different surfaces. As we continue to grow across our own website, Amazon, retail and other channels, we're bringing our social media and content creation **in\-house** . We're looking for someone who can help make DRENCH impossible to ignore online. The Role We're looking for a **creative, energetic and social\-media\-obsessed Content Creator** to take ownership of DRENCH's organic social media content. **This is not a traditional marketing desk job.** **We want someone who loves actually creating content** — filming, editing, experimenting with ideas, following trends, demonstrating products and finding new ways to make people stop scrolling. You'll have access to our products, colours, manufacturing operation and a huge variety of real\-world projects and surfaces to turn into content. You'll create content for **TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube Shorts** , with the freedom to test ideas and discover what audiences respond to. What You'll Be Creating Content will include: * Before\-and\-after paint transformations * Satisfying painting and transformation videos * Product demonstrations and tests * "Can you really paint this?" style videos * Painting tips, tricks and educational content * Trending TikTok/Reels formats adapted for DRENCH * Customer transformations and user\-generated content * Behind\-the\-scenes manufacturing content * Colour inspiration and room transformations * Product comparisons and demonstrations * New product launches * Reactive/trending content * Short\-form videos designed specifically to generate shares, comments and reach You'll also manage the day\-to\-day organic posting schedule across our social channels and help build an engaged community around the DRENCH brand. Who We're Looking For We're much more interested in **what you can create than what's written on your CV.** **You might already be a Content Creator, Social Media Executive, TikTok Creator, Videographer or someone who has simply become exceptionally good at creating social content yourself.** **Ideally, you'll:** * Understand TikTok, Instagram Reels and short\-form video extremely well * Know what makes someone stop scrolling * Be confident filming and editing video * Be comfortable appearing on camera when appropriate * Understand hooks, storytelling, retention and social trends * Have strong creative instincts * Be able to turn simple everyday situations into interesting content * Be comfortable testing lots of ideas rather than waiting for everything to be perfect * Understand that content made for social media shouldn't always look like a polished TV advertisement * Be proactive and constantly bring new ideas to the table Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, Canva or similar tools is useful, but **creative ability matters more to us than a particular piece of software.** What Success Looks Like This role isn't simply about keeping our Facebook and Instagram pages updated. We want to **build a serious organic audience around DRENCH** . You'll be encouraged to experiment, learn quickly and double down on content that works. We want to dramatically increase our organic reach, build audiences across Ireland and the UK, generate hundreds of thousands — and ultimately millions — of organic views, and turn DRENCH into a brand people recognise before they ever see an advertisement. Why Join DRENCH? You'll be joining at an exciting stage of the company's growth and will have a significant amount of creative freedom. Rather than creating content through layers of approvals, you'll work directly with the team and have access to the actual products, paint colours, manufacturing process and projects needed to create great content. If an idea is good, **we want you to make it.** How to Apply **Please don't just send us a CV.** **We want to see what you can do.** **Along with your application, please send us links to:** **Your TikTok / Instagram / portfolio, or 3–5 examples of content you've personally created.** **If you've grown an account or produced a video that performed particularly well, tell us about it and explain what you did.** **Shortlisted applicants may also be invited to complete a paid practical content task** as part of the selection process. * **If you're constantly thinking of content ideas, understand what makes social media tick and would love the freedom to help build a brand from the inside, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Software Engineer Graduate 2026/2027
description: **Company Description** Arista Networks pioneered data\-driven, cognitive cloud networking for large\-scale datacenter and campus environments. Arista's award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds from 10 to 400 gigabits per second, redefine scalability, agility and resilience. Arista has shipped more than 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Committed to open standards, Arista is a founding member of the 25/50G consortium. Arista Networks products are available worldwide directly and through partners. **Job Description** **Who You'll Work With** Arista Networks is looking for Graduate Engineers interested in learning world leading product development in C/C\+\+, Go, Java, and other languages. Join us at Arista Networks advancing the Software Defined Networking (SDN) revolution. **What You’ll Do** * Writing Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32\-bit drivers to DMA 64\-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller. * Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. * Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802\.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS). * Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform\-independent abstractions. * Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state. * Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peers * Accessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub\-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near\-real\-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics. * Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello. * Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C\+\+ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault\-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment. **Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields (Bachelor’s, Master’s, PhD) * Any of the following:\- C, C\+\+, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development. * Strong analytical skills * Ability to communicate effectively in a collaborative and highly technical team environment * Intellectual curiosity and passion for solving challenging problems using technology **Additional Information** The working hours will be agreed in advance with the team manager.

title: Uro - Oncology Clinical Nurse Specialist
description: **Job Description** **Job Title ;Uro\-Oncology Clinical Nurse Specialist** **Department ;Cancer Services** **Reports to ;CNM 3 Cancer Services** **Date ;2026** **Overall Purpose of Job** The Uro\-Oncology Clinical Nurse Specialist will have a pivotal role in meeting the clinical, psychological, emotional and information needs of cancer patients and their families and significant others within the urological cancer patient group including but not limited to bladder, kidney, prostate, testes and penis. He or she will be a key member of the multi\-disciplinary team responsible for the care of cancer patients and will provide exceptional patient care in an environment where quality, respect, caring and compassion are at the centre of all we do. The post holder will use clinical expertise, leadership education skills, and management skills and will be responsible for participating in the provision of specialist nursing service to patients with urological conditions. The post holder will work within the multidisciplinary team, to provide a proactive, comprehensive and coordinated service to patients undergoing investigation, diagnosis, treatment and follow up for patients with malignant urological disease. The post holder will be expected to participate in the planning, co\-ordination, and provision of direct specialist care to a caseload of patients and to develop, implement and embed a clear patient pathway for Urological Cancer patients in Beacon Hospital in line with NCCP recommendations and evidence\-based practice recommendations. In collaboration with the multi\-disciplinary team the post holder will provide support to Urology Consultants, Medical Oncologists, Radiation Oncologists, Consultant Radiologists, Nursing Colleagues, Allied Therapy and relevant Departments. The post holder will deliver care in line with the five core concepts of the Clinical Nurse Specialist Role set out in the Framework for the Establishment of the Clinical Nurse/Midwife Specialist Posts, 4th edition, National Council for the Professional Development of Nursing and Midwifery (NCNM) 2008\. **Key Responsibilities and Deliverables** The post holder's practice is based on the five core concepts of the Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS) role as defined by the NCNM 4th edition (2008\). These are the following: Clinical focus Patient/Client Advocate Education \& Training Audit \& Research Consultant **Clinical Focus** The Uro\-oncology nurse specialist will use specialist knowledge and skills to assess patients, plan, implement and evaluate care, providing advice and maintaining associated records. Act in a supportive and complementary role to Beacon Hospital Urology Oncology Service in the management of urology cancer patients through diagnosis, treatment and follow up care Evidence based care will be inherent in practice, ensuring best practice is disseminated. To provide highly specialised nursing care for patients with Uro\-oncology. Provide a specialist nursing service for patients with a diagnosis of urological cancer who require support and treatment through the continuum of care. Assist in the development of the service, by consultation, treatment intervention, complex and highly skilled communication, aftercare, education, training team building and working. Provides specialist education and training to other staff, patients and carers. Reviews patients and situations independently, and makes independent management decisions including requesting imaging. Provides highly developed specialist advice to patients and their families/carers, staff of all disciplines. In collaboration with the Urology and /or Medical/ Radiation Oncology Consultant, provides and receives highly sensitive, distressing, complex or contentious information to patients, their relatives and members of the public with empathy and reassurance. In collaboration with the Urology and/ or Medical / Radiation Oncology Consultant, provides psychological support to patients and their families' including the breaking bad news of a cancer diagnosis or disease progression on a regular basis. Develops skills to assess and interpret specialist information and conditions and takes appropriate action usually without the need to refer to other specialists. Track and maintain optimum co\-ordination of clinical cancer pathways for patients throughout diagnosis, treatment and follow up, liaising between all service providers. Provide skilled knowledge and giving advice re symptom/linking with MDT including palliative care as appropriate. Communicating with a range of other staff of all disciplines, acting as a highly specialist resource including liaison with health care providers within and outside the Trust regarding diagnosis and treatment advise. According to protocols and guidelines follow up the surgical urology cancer patients, organising investigations to monitor for recurrence of disease, breaking of bad news, referring patients on and discharging patients when appropriate. Undertake comprehensive patient assessment to include physical, psychological, social and spiritual elements of care using best evidence\-based practice in urology nursing. Use the outcomes of patient assessment to develop and implement plans of care/case management in conjunction with the multi\-disciplinary team (MDT) and the patient, family and/or carer as appropriate. Make alterations in the management of patient's condition in collaboration with the MDT, Urology, Oncology and Radiation Oncologists and the patient in line with agreed pathways and policies, procedures, protocols and guidelines. Monitor and evaluate the patient's response to treatment and amend the plan of care accordingly in conjunction with the MDT and patient, family and/or carer as appropriate. Accept appropriate referrals from MDT colleagues. Communicate with patients, family and/or carer as appropriate, to assess patient's needs and provide relevant support, information, education, advice and counselling as required. Demonstrate excellent communication skills with patients and carers ensuring information is appropriate, timely and delivered sensitively and based on individual need. Where appropriate work collaboratively with MDT colleagues across primary and secondary care to provide a seamless service delivery to the patient. Where required provide cover and support for the Urology Day Unit and other members of the Cancer Service CNS group. Assist with the planning, implementing and coordination of the urology multidisciplinary team meeting on a weekly basis. Co\-ordinate clinical follow up of urology patients following weekly MDT meeting. Take a lead role in ensuring the service for patients with Urological Cancer is in line with best practice guidelines including but not limited to National Cancer Control Programme, National Clinical Guideline No. 8, Diagnosis, staging and treatment of patients with prostate cancer. **Patient/Client Advocate** The postholder will: Communicate, negotiate and represent the patient's values and decisions in relation to their condition in collaboration with MDT colleagues. Develop and support the concept of advocacy, particularly in relation to patient participation in decision making, thereby enabling informed choice of treatment options. Discussing complex histology and staging scans results to patients, relatives/carers on a regular basis, discussing in detail the benefits and risks of various investigations and treatment options, and issues surrounding terminal illness. Using face to face clinics , telephone , e\-mail and letter to communicate highly complex and sensitive information effectively with patient and their carers recognising that individuals have differing needs for information at different phases of their illness, by using active listening, emotional engagement , empathy, tact, openness reassurance counselling, and emotional assessment to overcome patient anxiety, fear, altered perception, any mental health problems or cognitive impairment that may impair understanding and informed decision making and consent Respect and maintain the privacy, dignity and confidentiality of the patient. **Educational \& Training** The postholder will: Possess highly specialised knowledge regarding urological conditions and urological cancers. Maintain clinical competence in patient management within the speciality of urology nursing, keeping up\-to\-date with relevant research to ensure the implementation of evidence\-based practice. Recognise the opportunity for clinical supervision and access if appropriate. Assesses, develops and implements specialist nursing care programmes, for Uro\-Oncology. Participate in the development and education of new techniques in patient care in consultation with medical and nursing staff. Participate in in service training programmes for staff as appropriate. Be responsible for addressing own continuing professional development needs. Plans, delivers and evaluates education, study days and training programmes for all relevant disciplines of staff. Provides specialists training and education in informal and formal settings for nurses and other disciplines. Provide teaching in practice to nurses and other disciplines including medical staff through clinical supervision /facilitation. Act as a positive role model for other staff and students and provides strong leadership. Provide the patient, family and/or carer with appropriate information and other supportive interventions to increase their knowledge, skill and confidence in managing their condition. Ensure adequate patient education material is available and contribute to developing new educational material where required. Teaches patients and their families/carers about managing their own condition, where appropriate. Empower patients, carers and staff to realise and maintain their potential in relations to health and wellbeing. **Audit \& Research** The postholder will: Establish and maintain a register of patients within his/her caseload. Maintain a record of clinically relevant data aligned to National Key Performance Indicators (KPI's) as directed and advised by the CNM 3 Cancer Services and Head of Urology. Maintain a record of clinically relevant data in support of all Urology Cancers in compliance with NCCP guidelines in conjunction with Beacon Hospital Consultant Urological Surgeons. Maintain a record of clinically relevant data in support of the Robotic Assisted Radical Prostatectomy pathway as directed to ensure compliance with audit requirements of the National Cancer Control Programme. Participates in research within scope of professional practice. Identify, initiate and conduct nursing and MDT audit projects relevant to the area of practice. Identify, critically analyse, disseminate and integrate best evidence relating to urology nursing into practice Use the outcomes of audit to improve service provision. Support the development of building and collecting the relevant data sets for the group of patients. Lead on the developments of the operational policies and annual reports which will contain audits, data and reports covering patient outcomes, experience and workforce requirements. **Consultant** The postholder will: Provide leadership in clinical practice and act as a resource and role model. Use specialist knowledge to generate and contribute to the development of clinical standards and guidelines and support their implementation. Develop collaborative working relationships with MDT colleagues as appropriate to promote integrated care delivery. Support the Urology, Oncologists teams to develop clear guidelines and protocols to support this complex group of patients. Development of clear pathways guidance across multiple consultant services. **Managerial Responsibilities** The postholder will: Provide an efficient, effective and high\-quality service, respecting the needs of each patient, family and/or carer. Effectively manage time and caseload in order to meet changing and developing service needs. Continually monitor the service to ensure it reflects current need. Implement and manage identified changes. Ensure that confidentiality in relation to patient records is maintained. Maintain accurate and contemporaneous records and data on all matters pertaining to the planning, management, delivery and evaluation of care. Contribute to the service planning process as appropriate. Maintain a continuity in the provision of the CNS service. Be aware of budgetary limitations and provide highest quality nursing service within those confines. Make line manager aware of any concerns regarding the quality of service provided in a constructive manner. Asses the effectiveness and economy of working practices, make recommendations regarding clinical resources. Actively and positively participates in the ongoing preparations to ensure readiness for JCI and the sustainability of same in alignment with Beacon Hospital Strategic Plan and Cancer Services Strategic plan. **Professional Responsibilities** The postholder will: Practice in accordance with relevant legislation and with regard to The Scope of Nursing \& Midwifery Practice Framework (Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland, 2015\) and the Code of Professional Conduct and Ethics for Registered Nurses and Registered Midwives (Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland, 2014\) The post holder will have the freedom to act within the boundaries of their expertise working unsupervised and with autonomy in the clinical setting Maintain a high standard of professional behaviour and be professionally accountable for actions/omissions. Take measures to develop and maintain the competences required for professional practice. Adhere to the Beacon Hospital Values of results\-focus, collegiality, communication, dignity and excellence. Adhere to relevant legislation and regulation. Demonstrate in\-depth knowledge of the pathophysiology and assessment of urological conditions. Demonstrate the ability to formulate a plan of care based on findings and evidence\-based standards of care and practice guidelines. Demonstrate an understanding of the principles of risk management as they apply to the role. Develop professional working relationships within the hospital and wider national and international cancer network including: Pathology Radiology Diagnostics Urology Day Unit and Inpatient wards CNS / Liaison Nurses within other specialties and in other hospitals Clinical Trials Nurses in other hospitals **Person Specification** **Qualifications** NMBI Registered General Nurse in good standing. Post Graduate course completion in Clinical Practice, with focus on Urology or working towards same. **Experience** **(Amount and Type)** Minimum five years post registration experience. Three to five years' experience working in an environment caring for Urology patients. Experience working in the area of Oncology Function in an autonomous role, cognitive if the Scope of Practice as defined by NMBI The employee must speak, read and write grammatically correct English.
